To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
RENEW is a tool for fast, efficient implementation of checkpointing protocols.

(i) RENEW can be used to evaluate the behavior of different checkpoint protocols with standard benchmark codes, (ii) the coordinated checkpoint protocol can emulate the behavior of the communication-induced protocol, (iii) the message logging protocol can emulate the coordinated protocol, (iv) the performance of the coordinated and communication-induced protocols are comparable and (v) all protocols require a similar amount of execution time to restore the system to a consistent state.

RENEW is a tool that allows the rapid implementation of a wide range of checkpoint protocols, that the performance of the communication-induced protocol is comparable to the performance of the coordinated protocol and that message logging degrades the performance but requires a similar time to restore the state.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a run-time environment that allows rapid prototyping of checkpoint/restart protocols for parallel applications.
the development of a run-time environment for the rapid testing of a wide variety of checkpointing protocols.
the implementation and evaluation of a system that allows the rapid prototyping of checkpoint protocols.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
RENEW is a useful tool to test checkpoint protocols.
the performance of the three protocols evaluated was comparable, with the message logging protocol being slightly slower.
the coordinated checkpoint protocol is the most promising approach.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
RENEW provides the flexibility and ease of use to support the rapid prototyping of a wide variety of protocols.
, for the applications tested in this work, the coordinated protocol is the most efficient and the message logging protocol is the safest.
the RENEW system is capable of providing the user with a flexible and efficient environment for the implementation and evaluation of a broad range of checkpoint protocols.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a flexible and extensible run-time system, such as RENEW, is a valuable tool for the design and testing of checkpoint protocols.
the RENEW framework provides the means to rapidly test a broad range of checkpoint protocols.
RENEW is a flexible and extensible tool for the implementation and evaluation of checkpoint protocols.
